name: Keyword Research Tool
description: Keyword research tool for Python and the command line: expand one seed into up to 500 Google autocomplete keywords (questions, alphabet, prepositions, comparisons) with Google's relevance score, or read the raw suggestions of any query, as JSON or CSV. Free and open source; no Google Ads account or proxies needed.

commands.name: ideas
commands.help: keyword ideas expanded from one seed
commands.description: Keyword suggestions people actually type, expanded from one seed.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: The keyword to expand, e.g. "keyword research".

inputs.name: modes
inputs.description: Which probe families to run: seed, alphabet, questions, prepositions, comparisons (default seed, questions and alphabet).

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Google market, as an ISO country code (us, gb, de...).

inputs.name: lang
inputs.description: Interface language, e.g. en, it, de.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many keywords to deliver at most (1–500). You pay only for delivered keywords.

commands.name: suggest
commands.help: Google autocomplete suggestions for one query
commands.description: Raw Google autocomplete suggestions for one seed query, with Google's relevance score.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: The query to complete, e.g. "keyword research" or a partial one like "keyword res".

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Google market, as an ISO country code (us, gb, de...).

inputs.name: lang
inputs.description: Interface language, e.g. en, it, de.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many suggestions to deliver at most (1–20). You pay only for delivered suggestions.
